label: Week 5 brief
meaning: Cincinnati won with the run game this brief told it to avoid: 31 carries for 117 yards, a season high [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/bengals-feel-the-formula-after-melting-dolphins-joe-burrow-zac-taylor). Burrow had no turnovers, and Jordan Battle, flagged here for missed tackles, made both interceptions [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/bengals-dolphins-recap-postgame-notes-quotes-stats-week-5-2026). The brief missed the real problem: Miami ran for 217 yards [Heavy](https://heavy.com/sports/nfl/miami-dolphins/jeff-hafley-nfl-news-offense-history-week-5/), and that run defence now faces Baltimore after the bye.

storylines.title: Burrow's late-game turnovers
storylines.fact: He threw for 428 yards last week, with two interceptions. Both came when Jacksonville did not blitz [AP](https://www.yourvalley.net/stories/burrow-stays-calm-with-bengals-at-2-2-but-injuries-to-chase-and-higgins-will-impact-game-plan,726013). Since 2024 he leads the NFL in fourth-quarter and overtime turnovers [TSN](https://www.tsn.ca/nfl/article/burrow-after-bengals-second-straight-loss-not-armageddon-n1-50105859/).
storylines.why: **Why it matters:** yardage is not the issue. Decisions against four-man rushes are.

storylines.title: Chase and Higgins: the Friday upgrade
storylines.fact: Both went from no practice early in the week to full practice Friday. Both are questionable [Local 12](https://local12.com/sports/bengals/bengals-jamarr-chase-tee-higgins-injury-report-dolphins-week-5). Chase still has to clear the concussion protocol.
storylines.why: **Non-obvious:** the worst case is not both out. It is both in and limited, with a plan built around players who tire early.

storylines.title: The run game is a symptom, not the disease
storylines.fact: The Bengals ran 15 times for 23 yards [TSN](https://www.tsn.ca/nfl/article/burrow-after-bengals-second-straight-loss-not-armageddon-n1-50105859/). But Chase Brown caught all 11 of his targets [WCPO](https://www.wcpo.com/sports/football/bengals/well-take-them-day-to-day-taylor-gives-updates-on-chase-higgins-injuries). Short passes are doing the work of runs.
storylines.why: **Why it matters:** Miami's run defence ranks sixth at 3.6 yards per carry [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/bengals-visit-dolphins-with-jamarr-chase-tee-higgins-injured/). Forcing carries pays poorly.

storylines.title: A thin secondary that misses tackles
storylines.fact: Safety Kyle Dugger is out and Bryan Cook is questionable [Local 12](https://local12.com/sports/bengals/bengals-jamarr-chase-tee-higgins-injury-report-dolphins-week-5). Jordan Battle missed three tackles last week that let Jacksonville convert third-and-longs [AP](https://www.yourvalley.net/stories/burrow-stays-calm-with-bengals-at-2-2-but-injuries-to-chase-and-higgins-will-impact-game-plan,726013).
storylines.why: **Why it matters:** Miami's weak passing game (Willis: 56.3%, one touchdown) will hide this. Better offences will not.

storylines.title: Last game before the bye
storylines.fact: After the bye, Cincinnati plays at Baltimore on Oct. 25. A win over a winless team will hide every problem above.
storylines.why: **Why it matters:** a star who re-injures himself Sunday costs the Baltimore game too.

watch.title: Read the inactives
watch.text: Inactives come out 90 minutes before kickoff. Check Chase and Higgins first. If Chase plays, watch whether he runs full routes or gets a managed snap count.
watch.after: Both played and neither was held back: Chase took 89% of snaps and Higgins 69% [A to Z Sports](https://atozsports.com/nfl/cincinnati-bengals-news/bengals-week-5-snap-counts-at-dolphins-bj-hill-jamarr-chase-tee-higgins/).

watch.title: Does Miami blitz Burrow?
watch.text: Both interceptions came with no blitz. Coach Jeff Hafley ran the Packers' defence in 2024 and 2025 [Dolphins notes](https://static.clubs.nfl.com/image/upload/dolphins/roq5llpxnsstbgy9eeuu). Expect disguised coverages and few blitzes.
watch.after: Miami sat in shell coverage, gave up short throws and never sacked Burrow [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/bengals-dolphins-postgame-quotes-week-5-2026). No blitz count was published.

watch.title: Pass rush against Willis
watch.text: Cincinnati has 14 sacks, tied for third. Dexter Lawrence has three [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/bengals-visit-dolphins-with-jamarr-chase-tee-higgins-injured/), but he missed Friday's practice.
watch.after: Lawrence played 43 snaps [A to Z Sports](https://atozsports.com/nfl/cincinnati-bengals-news/bengals-week-5-snap-counts-at-dolphins-bj-hill-jamarr-chase-tee-higgins/) and Willis was sacked three times [Heavy](https://heavy.com/sports/nfl/miami-dolphins/jeff-hafley-nfl-news-offense-history-week-5/). Boye Mafe and Barrett Carter had the reported sacks.

watch.title: Burrow's dropback count
watch.text: He dropped back 58 times last week [TSN](https://www.tsn.ca/nfl/article/burrow-after-bengals-second-straight-loss-not-armageddon-n1-50105859/). Near 40 suggests a lead. Near 55 suggests a close game or a failed run plan.
watch.after: Burrow threw 32 passes and was not sacked, so about 32 dropbacks [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/bengals-feel-the-formula-after-melting-dolphins-joe-burrow-zac-taylor). The low count matched a lead.

watch.title: Meyers does three jobs
watch.text: Last week he caught seven passes and returned eight kicks and punts [Fantasy Footballers](https://www.thefantasyfootballers.com/news/640886/tee-higgins-deemed-day-to-day/). If a star sits, his load climbs. Watch his ball security.
watch.after: Both stars played, so Meyers got just 19 snaps [A to Z Sports](https://atozsports.com/nfl/cincinnati-bengals-news/bengals-week-5-snap-counts-at-dolphins-bj-hill-jamarr-chase-tee-higgins/). His late mistake was stepping out at the 1 on a punt return [Yahoo](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/cincinnati-bengals-5-takeaways-31-140200359.html).

devilsAdvocate: **The offence is fine.** Burrow completed 72% of his passes last week [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/bengals-visit-dolphins-with-jamarr-chase-tee-higgins-injured/). The two losses were by 3 and 5 points. A small sample, not a flaw, may explain the late interceptions.

**Miami is better than 0–4.** It held Kenneth Walker and Aaron Jones under 100 yards each and lost to Minnesota by five [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/bengals-visit-dolphins-with-jamarr-chase-tee-higgins-injured/). Seven points on the road is a lot to ask.
**"Questionable" may mean "playing."** If both stars play at full strength, half of this page stops mattering.

alternativeView.title: The same game, from Miami
alternativeView.text: This is Miami's best chance to win: Cincinnati just lost at home, two stars are hobbled and Burrow makes late mistakes. Miami's run defence ranks sixth [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/bengals-visit-dolphins-with-jamarr-chase-tee-higgins-injured/), so the plan is to keep it close and wait for the late mistake. The catch: Willis has one touchdown pass all season, so Miami cannot win a shootout.
